change_log.summary: Knowledge decomposition, classification, regeneration rules and daily reconciliation (MKOS Continuous Knowledge Ingestion, Decomposition, Knowledge Evolution, Dynamic Propagation and Daily Reconciliation Directive).
Clinical pearls as durable governed assets: basis fingerprints, regeneration rules, flag and review, wider links.

title: Knowledge decomposition, classification and daily reconciliation
principle: Documents become source material; structured knowledge becomes the operational layer. Every recommendation is decomposed into criteria, objectives, competencies, teaching points and educational targets, deterministically wherever rules can; every object carries a classification; only what changed is reprocessed; a daily reconciliation repairs whatever slipped.

per_recommendation: Claim (claim_kind eligibility | contraindication | not_recommended | exception | monitoring | threshold), parsed by rules from the statement and its class of recommendation
Objective (objective_type learning) and Objective (objective_type assessment), with difficulty, competencies and subcompetencies, linked to the recommendation, its concepts and their blueprint topics
EducationalObject teaching_point, carrying its educational targets (question, flashcard, case, review)
EducationalObject high_yield (strong recommendation with level A evidence or board relevance at or above high_yield_board)
EducationalObject common_error (class 3: harm or no benefit, or a contraindication)
per_concept: EducationalObject lesson_target (at least lesson_target_min_recs current recommendations)
EducationalObject review_target (board relevance at or above review_target_board)
EducationalObject clinical_pearl (free AI only, within the daily MKOS AI budget; pending validation, never authoritative until reviewed)
per_section: EducationalObject clinical_pathway: the recommendations of one guideline section in order (at least pathway_min_recs)
decomposition.remediation_and_review_objectives: learner-specific: computed from learner state by the adaptive curriculum (remediate, review) over these objectives rather than stored per learner
decomposition.note_versions: rules_version marks how recommendations are decomposed (raise it to re-decompose everything); backfill_version marks the retroactive pass (raise it to run the backfill again).

competency_rules.when: graded (class and level of evidence present)
screening, testing, measurement, evaluation or diagnosis
a threshold, a test result or a measured value decides the action
treatment, therapy, a drug, a dose, a procedure or a referral
class 2a or 2b, exceptions, or a weak recommendation (judgment required)
board relevance at or above high_yield_board

classification.note: Derived like scores: kept on the object without making a new content version.

reconciliation.note: Runs with the Life OS daily refresh (midnight America/New_York); if a day is missed it runs at the next opportunity.

pearls.principle: Clinical pearls are durable educational assets: generate once, validate, classify, version, store in the pearl registry, reuse. Never regenerate an identical pearl.
pearls.registry: EducationalObject records with edu_kind clinical_pearl (ids eo.pe.<concept>.<n>), linked derived_from their recommendations, covers their concept, develops the competencies and mapped_to_blueprint the blueprint topics of the objectives those recommendations yield; persisted to Drive with every other object.
pearls.reuse: Served by topic context to every lesson, question, flashcard, case, review and tutor answer on the concept, and through the graph to anything reaching the same recommendation, objective, competency or blueprint topic.
regenerate_when: the pearl is flagged for review and the owner sends it for regeneration
the pearl fails validation (rejected at review)
pearls.validation: Generated pearls enter pending_validation and are labelled unvalidated wherever they are shown; the owner validates (asset_review ok) or rejects (asset_review regenerate, which regenerates it). A learner's flag withholds the pearl until reviewed.
